ownerReport: Challenge recipients landed in a non-Chaos game mode instead of the Chaos Clash flow.

investigation.method: traced every code path that mints a challenge link from a Chaos result and every code path that consumes one; CSS was NOT assumed to be the cause

linkMinters.recipientLands: ChallengeInvite (Chaos flow, same opening rolls and rules)

linkMinters.where: src/App.jsx doShare() -> src/challengeClient.js createChallenge(team, rec) -> /challenge/{id} (api/share-page.js meta-refresh) -> /?ch={id}
linkMinters.recipientLands: pre-9C 'YOU'VE BEEN CHALLENGED' Dream builder via setChallenge + setNav('Challenges')
linkMinters.correct: only for Dream / Best 7 / Win 82 / Tournament / Daily results

investigation.defect: On a CHAOS result, ResultView -> Postgame received onChallenge={doShare} and onShare={doShare} (src/App.jsx renderReport). Postgame renders '⚔️ Challenge a Friend' for mode 'single' (a Chaos result is type 'single', tag 'chaos'), and doShare ALWAYS called the legacy createChallenge(team, rec) and appended '(or take the direct challenge: /challenge/{id})' to the share text. A recipient who followed that link was routed by the legacy /?ch= handler into the roster-challenge builder, not the Chaos flow. The governed ChallengeShare was also present on the same result, so two different challenge products were offered from one Chaos result.
notCauses: CSS/theme (the routing decision is made in App.jsx before any presentation)
the 9C invitation codec (EC-XXXX-XXXX links resolve to ChallengeInvite in every mode tested)
the /?chaos= deep link (still resolves to the Chaos flow)

changes: renderReport: onChallenge={live && res?.tag !== 'chaos' ? doShare : null} — the legacy Challenge CTA is withdrawn on a Chaos result; the governed ChallengeShare is the only challenge surface there.

doShare: const legacyChallenge = result?.tag !== 'chaos'; createChallenge is called only for legacy modes, and the '(or take the direct challenge: …)' line is emitted only when a legacy challenge exists. Share on a Chaos result shares the published result / origin only.
preserved: legacy /?c=, /?ch= and /challenge/{id} formats and their codec (src/challengeClient.js verbatim)
legacy Challenge a Friend for Dream, Best 7, Win 82, Tournament and Daily
9C invitation validation, guest/auth handling, attempt limits, expiration, revocation, comparison semantics, rating/XP eligibility (api/challenge*.js untouched)

asserts: a completed Chaos result shows the governed ChallengeShare and NO legacy 'Challenge a Friend' CTA
the legacy /?ch= route still opens the roster builder (J6 preserved)
a /?challenge=EC-… invitation resolves to the Chaos invite surface
